data.name: Mifrah
data.gender_notes: Mifrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A place of learning and guidance
data.long_meaning: A place of learning and guidance from Allah, often used to describe a mosque or a religious school. The name Mifrah carries the meaning “A place of learning and guidance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mifrah usually hope their child will grow to embody a place of learning and guidance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of seeking knowledge and wisdom from the divine
data.etymology: Mifrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A place of learning and guidance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mifrah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مِفرح
in_arabic.meaning: الفرح و الصحة، مِن سُمع مِفارِحٍ مِنَ اللَهِ
in_arabic.long_meaning: مِفرح: مِن سُمع مِفارِحٍ مِنَ اللَهِ، وَهِيَ مِنَ اللاتِي تَنَفَسُ اللَهُ بِهَا بِخَيْرٍ، وَتُذَكِّرُهُ بِفَضْلِهِ، وَتُذَكِّرُهُ بِحُسْنِ عَملِهِ، وَتُذَكِّرُهُ بِوُدِّهِ، وَتُذَكِّرُهُ بِحُسْنِ مَواعِدِهِ.

in_urdu.name: مِفرح
in_urdu.meaning: خوشی اور صحت، اللہ کی خوشیوں کی وجہ سے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مِفرح: اللہ کی خوشیوں کی وجہ سے، یہ وہ خواتین ہیں جو اللہ پر خوش ہیں، اور اللہ کے فضائل کو یاد دلاتی ہیں، اور اللہ کی نیک عملوں کو یاد دلاتی ہیں، اور اللہ کے محبوب ہونے کو یاد دلاتی ہیں، اور اللہ کے بہترین مواقع کو یاد دلاتی ہیں.

in_hindi.name: मिफ्राह
in_hindi.meaning: खुशी और स्वास्थ्य, अल्लाह की खुशियों की वजह से
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिफ्राह: अल्लाह की खुशियों की वजह से, वे महिलाएं हैं जो अल्लाह पर खुश होती हैं, और अल्लाह के फजल को याद दिलाती हैं, और अल्लाह के नेक कामों को याद दिलाती हैं, और अल्लाह के प्रेम को याद दिलाती हैं, और अल्लाह के बेहतरीन मौकों को याद दिलाती हैं।

in_pashto.name: مِفرح
in_pashto.meaning: خوشی او صحت، د الله د خوشیو د له
in_pashto.long_meaning: مِفرح: د الله د خوشیو د له، چېرې دا د الله په خپل ښه ملموس کړی، له په ښه ملموس، د الله په بړځ، او د الله په نیک عملو.

in_english.name: Mifrah
in_english.meaning: Happiness and health, from hearing good tidings from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Mifrah: From hearing good tidings from Allah, these women are blessed with Allah's goodness, and they remind Allah of His own blessings, and they remind Allah of His own good deeds, and they remind Allah of His own love, and they remind Allah of His own good intentions.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل

data.cultural_impact: The term "Mifrah" has its roots in the Arabic language, and in Islamic culture, it is often used to refer to a place where knowledge and guidance are sought and shared. Historically, mosques served as community centers where people gathered for prayer, learning, and socializing. The concept of a "Mifrah" embodies the idea that mosques are not just places of worship, but also hubs for intellectual and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, a "Mifrah" is considered a sacred space where one can connect with Allah and seek guidance from the Quran and Hadith. This concept is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition, and the pursuit of knowledge is seen as a means of drawing closer to God. By studying the Quran and Hadith, and engaging in intellectual discourse and debate, Muslims believe they can deepen their understanding of Allah and His will for humanity. Ultimately, the goal of a "Mifrah" is to facilitate spiritual growth and inspire individuals to lead virtuous lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "A place of learning and guidance" symbolizes A place of learning and guidance from Allah, often used to describe a mosque or a religious school. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mifrah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of a place of learning and guidance.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Mifrah is the name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) mentioned in Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.
historical_references.context: Mifrah is believed to have been a resident of Medina and was known for her generosity and hospitality. She was also one of the wives of Umar ibn Al-Khattab.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mifrah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
